I never once said the pricing or costs were too expensive to this lady. The receptionist was condescending & if their office staff is this offensive and rude to a new, inquiring person… I don’t want to imagine how the Drs and staff will treat my fur babies while I’m not around & I leave my pets in their care. Let me assure you that of I could give no stats or negative, I would!!   DO NOT GO TO THIS FACILITY!!!!! I had taken my pets to champions vet for over 10 yrs when Dr Sarter was there.  Hands down, the best ever!!!!  I won’t ever be able to replace him! I have looked more for 6 yrs.  So when my gsd got sick again, I just naturally felt comfortable with calling them again as I was desperate for answers. Well let me assure you, this was a much larger mistake than you can imagine.  Issues: 1. rude front desk. 2. While in speaking with Doctor, and they have my dog in back for X-rays, the tech comes busting in telling Doctor to ‘hurry and come see’.  What?!!!!   3.  Doctor comes back in to inform me that my dog has cancer EVERYWHERE!   In her stomach, chest, possibly heart, so now e need a heart worm test for another $100 also, even after assuring her of her meds and recent test. Negative.  But now we need to pay another $100 for a rush review from radiologist. We are now at $1400!!!  I went to grab lunch and when I came back (had been there all day) was told radiologist said she didn’t have cancer and she just needs ultrasound now!! SO NO CANCER!!  From completely engulfed to nope!  No joke.  4. Asked them to simply look in dogs nose to see if obstructed.  Never would. Even with simple scope used to see on regular exams.  Refused
I told the receptionist this later and she swore they looked, and she saw her look while in back (I just didn’t see it). I didn’t want to argue so I asked her to ask the doctor…. Needless to say she didn’t come back to answer me but Doctor admitted she did not look when she came on. This place is a joke.  More than breaks my heart of the change.  Oh and I left out of there with no answers, no meds and a $2400 invoice paid in full.  Thanks for the experience.

I brought my cat Sabo here for some pain he was experiencing on his rear. The vet told me before getting x-rays and blood test that and i quote her “will send these off to someone that can actually read em, so it will take a while.” I shoulda left right then and there before i dropped $900. Later get a call back saying that the problem is swollen large intestines and he has asthma. Okay cool, well a week later the problems getting worse so i take him to a vet in conroe, TURNS OUT HE HAS CANCER. Now my beloved Sabo is unable to use his back legs or even feel pain back there. AND according to the other doctor he doesn’t even have asthma and the large intestines was just swollen from possible digestion. The vet i took him too in Conroe broke down the entire blood work to me even explained why his diagnosis was the way it was. Now my hearts broken cause ima have to put my child to rest. I wouldn’t recommend this location to my worst enemy. My anger towards this location is beyond astronomical.
